usedFor: Zoho CRM holds your leads, and each “New Lead” becomes a card in Upwave.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM, then “Create Card” in Upwave
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead appears as an Upwave card, so the team can pick it up on the board.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Zoho CRM is polling, so “Create Card” runs after a scheduled check.
